random.description: Random split / K-fold: rows are shuffled, so the same country appears in training and test (different years). Answers: 'how well can the model fill in a country-year it has partly seen?' — typically the most optimistic.

group.description: Country-grouped split / GroupKFold: every country is entirely in training *or* test. Answers: 'how well does the model estimate happiness for a country it has never seen?'

temporal.description: Forward-in-time split: train on earlier years, test on later years. Answers: 'how well do patterns learned from the past carry over to future observations?'

best_model.name: Random Forest
best_model.selection_rule: Lowest validation RMSE on held-out countries (country-grouped split); MAE as tie-breaker. R² is reported but not used alone.
